rga_fa18_inb.description: Final efficiency divisor for Fa18 Inb. Stored value is the combined correction epsilon_final(I) = epsilon_data_rel(I) * (epsilon_data_rel(I) / epsilon_mc_rel(I)) = epsilon_data_rel(I)^2 / epsilon_mc_rel(I). cross_sections.cpp then applies 1 / epsilon_final(I), which simultaneously corrects to zero current and corrects for MC being more efficient than data at the same current. Data relative efficiency uses slope -0.2537662628 +/- 0.0196421015 (% per nA); MC relative efficiency uses slope -0.1579733848 +/- 0.0016897544 (% per nA).
